fixes.title: LanguageSwitcher Physical Alignment and Dropdown Anchoring

before.ltrRtlIssue: Dropdown anchored to right even in RTL, and text-left forced LTR reading style inside language selector.

after.rtlExperience: Dropdown aligns to the left (logical end) of the switcher, options align to the right.
after.ltrExperience: Dropdown aligns to the right (logical end) of the switcher, options align to the left.

fixes.title: Search Inputs Physical Padding and Icon Anchoring

before.ltrIssue: In English, text entered under the magnifying glass icon at the right edge, while left edge had empty space.

after.inputPadding: rtl:pr-9 rtl:pl-3 ltr:pl-9 ltr:pr-3 (and equivalent in reports/pricing)
after.rtlExperience: Search icon anchored on the right, text starts with right padding.
after.ltrExperience: Search icon anchored on the left, text starts with left padding.

before.ltrIssue: In English, headers and cells were aligned to the opposite side of reading flow, and vertical divider borders were attached to the wrong side of columns.

after.rtlExperience: Headers and cell contents right-aligned, vertical dividing borders on the left edge.
after.ltrExperience: Headers and cell contents left-aligned, vertical dividing borders on the right edge.

before.tabletIssue: On 768–1024px viewport widths, 17 tabs overflowed abruptly at the edges without clear visual cues indicating horizontal scrollability.

after.navigationContainer: Enclosed in header-nav-container with bidirectional edge fade gradient affordances (start-0 / end-0)
after.tabletExperience: Subtle edge gradient cues naturally communicate scrollability while smooth scrolling maintains frictionless navigation across all 17 tabs.

fixes.title: Mobile Touch Targets on Weight & Pricing Presets

before.buttonHeights: py-0.5 and py-1 resulting in ~20-28px hit targets
before.accessibilityIssue: On mobile devices, preset chips and filter pills were difficult to tap reliably, violating the ~44x44px touch target guideline.

after.buttonHeights: min-h-[44px] on mobile (responsive min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0) with increased padding (px-3 py-2 sm:px-2.5 sm:py-1)
after.touchExperience: Fingertip-friendly ~44px tap targets on touch devices, collapsing neatly on desktop.

verification.audit72_04_searchInputs: VERIFIED (Direction-aware padding and icon positioning across 4 views)
verification.audit72_05_tables: VERIFIED (rtl:text-right ltr:text-left, rtl:border-l ltr:border-r across 3 views)
verification.audit72_06_tabletNavigation: VERIFIED (Overflow edge gradient affordance added, all 17 tabs intact)
verification.audit72_07_mobileTouchTargets: VERIFIED (min-h-[44px] on mobile for weight presets and pricing filter chips)
